newsitem.title: UK: Bates in buyout talks with Cordiant -paper.
newsitem.headline: Bates in buyout talks with Cordiant -paper.

text.p: The management of advertising agency Bates Worldwide is in talks about a partial buyout from British parent Cordiant Plc, The Times reported on Thursday.
There has been speculation this week that Cordiant is planning to demerge Bates, one of its two major advertising agencies, the other being Saatchi & Saatchi.
Part of the rationale is that the two agencies have trouble competing for rival clients in the same field.
The Times said the latest proposal was for a partial buyout after the idea of selling Bates had been rejected. It would give Bates managers up to 40 percent of the network.

"The stake would be sold at a slight discount to what is considered to be its market value and the cash raised from such a deal would be returned to Cordiant shareholders through a special dividend," the paper said.
